name: Takasugi Shinsaku
source:
Hobby: Having Unprotected Sleep

As an indomitable man since childhood, Shinsaku values his own faith--live free or die--more than anything. His excellent swordsmanship has been described as "fast as the lightning, powerful as the storm."

[Edited from [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/baku.html]English official site[/url]]
